items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: out of this, there was a band started by a fellow named George McCaskel, who was a saxophone player, and we used to play -- and he had the band at the Elks Rest with the school kids

ctx.x: He has a big church there in Montgomeryere. There ws also a guy who played trombone we called 'Foots' - but he died very young. I can't remember Foots' real name. And then in the saxophone section, there was George Kelly, George McCaskel --
What did George McCaskel play -- alto or tenor?
